name: Day Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233761 (130 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Great Divide RD) on the east shore of Day Lake ~1 mi N of Clam Lake. 52 sites (Blueberry & Heron loops), swim beach, fishing pier, 6 barrier-free paved sites. ~25 sites reservable online, remainder FCFS. --Claude

name: East Twin Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233759 (131 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Great Divide RD) on 110-acre East Twin Lake near Clam Lake. Sites 1-2 accommodate 40-ft back-in RVs, others up to 30 ft, fishing pier. Boat ramp ~0.5 mi E. 6 sites reservable online, remainder FCFS. --Claude

name: Black Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233758 (131 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Great Divide RD) on Black Lake. 29 sites (3 walk-in tent-only); back-in only. Most sites lakefront. 17 reservable online + 12 FCFS. --Claude

name: Sailor Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233762 (112 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Medford-Park Falls RD) on 170-acre Sailor Lake, Flambeau Trail access. 25 sites (23-25 tent-only, 12 double/group). Sites 1-12/24/25 reservable online, 13-23 FCFS. --Claude

name: Spearhead Point Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233766 (131 days observed, edges closes)
note: Rustic Chequamegon NF (Medford-Park Falls RD) campground on Mondeaux Flowage. Hand-pump drinking water; some sites over 40 ft. Reservable online; premium ('P') sites have small docks. --Claude

name: Eastwood Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233763 (88 days observed, edges closes)
note: Rustic Chequamegon NF (Medford-Park Falls RD) campground on Mondeaux Flowage. 2 vault toilets; most sites over 35 ft. 5 reservable online. Open ~May 2-Oct 31. --Claude

name: Two Lakes Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233767 (154 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Washburn RD) - wooded sites between Lake Owen and Bass Lake. Primitive, swim beach. Season ~May-Oct. Mix of reservable (recreation.gov) and FCFS sites. Drive-in, accommodates RVs. --Claude

name: Twin Lakes Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233764 (120 days observed, edges closes)

booking.note: recreation.gov: reservations close 4 days before arrival, 14-night maximum, no minimum stay.

note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Medford-Park Falls RD), Twin Lakes Recreation Area. Sites 5-11 reservable on recreation.gov (no minimum stay), rest FCFS. A 28-ft rig reportedly fit (23-ft fine). --Claude

name: Arrowhead Point (Lake Greeson)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10119575 (88 days observed, edges closes)
note: USACE campground on Lake Greeson with swim beach and boat ramp. Pay on-site via recreation.gov mobile app. RV Life unrated. --Claude

name: Little Coon Creek Park (Gillham Lake)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234767 (232 days observed, edges closes)
note: USACE campground on Gillham Lake (Cossatot River project). 9 electric RV sites plus group shelter. Reservable online. --Claude
